content.short: PaidXPO is a deflationary creator-focused memecoin on Cardano that turns exposure into actual currency.
content.description: PaidXPO ($PDXPO) is a deflationary memecoin on the Cardano blockchain with a unique mission: to empower the creative community. Inspired by the common challenge of creators being offered 'exposure' instead of cash, PaidXPO flips the script by turning that exposure into a tangible digital currency. Featuring the funky mascot XPO, the project combines meme culture with social utility, providing photographers, videographers, and other artists with a new way to monetize their work. It stands as a community-driven project that supports the growth of the decentralized creator economy.
